children: Tamboran Resources Corp reported a fiscal 2026 net loss attributable to stockholders of $(26.1)M versus a $(36.9)M loss in FY 2025, with no revenue recognized in either year as initial gas sales occurred after the reporting period during commissioning activity.
Revenue was $— for FY 2026 and $— for FY 2025 (no natural gas production revenue recognized; initial gas sales occurred after period end).
Net income (loss) attributable to Tamboran stockholders: $(26.1)M for FY 2026 vs. $(36.9)M for FY 2025 (improvement of $10.8M YoY).
Diluted earnings per share: $(1.161) for FY 2026 vs. $(2.517) for FY 2025 (loss per share narrowed YoY).
Production start & commissioning: First gas sales began Sept. 5, 2026 during SPCF commissioning; company plans to ramp to a 40 TJ/d plateau.
Drilling & stimulation: Completed the largest Beetaloo stimulation program to date (178 stages across ~30,000 ft); multiwell SS1 and SS2 programs are progressing.
Asset & acreage position: Operator on key permits EPs 76, 98, 117, 136 and 143 and holds a 25% non-op interest in EP161, with roughly 2.8M net prospective acres in the Beetaloo Basin.
Operational cost pressures & mitigations: Management cited supply-chain and inflationary cost pressures and said it has pre-purchased long-lead items and secured rig options to mitigate impacts.
Midstream milestone: The SPCF is about 90% constructed, with commissioning ongoing and initial constrained sales targeted to the Northern Territory market.
